forbidden_contradiction_skips.point: Cruelty under Section 86 refers only to physical violence.
forbidden_contradiction_skips.sentence: Cruelty as defined under Section 86 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023, encompasses two main aspects: (a) any wilful conduct that is likely to drive a woman to commit suicide or to cause grave injury or danger to her life, limb, or health (mental or physical), and (b) harassment of the woman intended to coerce her or her relatives to meet unlawful demands for property or valuable security, or due to their failure to meet such demands.

required_point_details.point: Section 86 defines cruelty for the purposes of Section 85 as: (a) any wilful conduct of such a nature as is likely to drive the woman to commit suicide or cause grave injury or danger to life, limb or health (mental or physical); or (b) harassment of the woman where such harassment is with a view to coercing her or any person related to her to meet any unlawful demand for property or valuable security.

final_answer_preview: Cruelty as defined under Section 86 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023, encompasses two main aspects: (a) any wilful conduct that is likely to drive a woman to commit suicide or to cause grave injury or danger to her life, limb, or health (mental or physical), and (b) harassment of the woman intended to coerce her or her relatives to meet unlawful demands for property or valuable security, or due to their failure to meet such demands. This section highlights the serious nature of actions that can be classified as cruelty.
